demo.questionTitle: What happens to a plant if it is completely blocked from sunlight?
demo.questionDescription: Experience the real-time interactive feedback students see during gameplay! 👇
demo.choice1Text: It grows faster searching for a light source
demo.choice1FeedbackMessage: The plant may reach upward briefly but will quickly wilt. Plants are highly dependent on light to produce food.
demo.choice1FeedbackTip: Hint: The food-making process in plants is called photosynthesis.
demo.choice2Text: It wilts and gradually dies as it can't produce food
demo.choice2FeedbackMessage: Without sunlight, a plant cannot perform photosynthesis to produce the energy (glucose) it needs to survive and grow.
demo.choice2FeedbackTip: Extra info: The green chlorophyll molecule is what absorbs light and triggers the chemical reaction that produces food.
demo.choice3FeedbackMessage: Leaves turn yellow, not blue — caused by the breakdown of green chlorophyll due to lack of light.
demo.choice3FeedbackTip: Hint: Yellowing leaves are the first sign of insufficient light in plants.
demo.choice4Text: It continues to grow normally without any effect
demo.choice4FeedbackMessage: Light is the lifeline of a plant. No green plant can live and grow normally in complete darkness.
demo.choice4FeedbackTip: Note: Some fungi grow in the dark, but they are not true plants and do not perform photosynthesis.

policiesPage.title: Terms of Service & Privacy Policy
policiesPage.s1Body: Welcome to our platform. By using our website and services, you agree to comply with these terms and policies. This platform is designed to provide a safe, interactive educational environment for teachers and students using the latest AI and real-time analysis technologies.
policiesPage.s2Intro: We are committed to protecting your privacy and processing data with full transparency:
policiesPage.s2Item1: We do not require students to create accounts, log in, or provide any personal data (such as email or passwords) to play games. Students join using nicknames they choose themselves.
policiesPage.s2Item2: We collect basic registration information from teachers (such as name, email, and profile picture) to secure their accounts and manage their games and organizations.
policiesPage.s2Item3: We use essential cookies to maintain the teacher's login session via the NextAuth (Auth.js) system.
policiesPage.s3Intro: To deliver our advanced services, we integrate the following technologies:
policiesPage.s3Item1: When using the auto-generation feature, the lesson topic or idea is sent to Google's AI models for processing. No personal data of students or teachers is sent to AI servers.
policiesPage.s3Item2: We use PostHog analytics to monitor teacher behavior inside the dashboard to improve usability and performance. We do not track any student behavior outside of classroom game statistics.
policiesPage.s3Item3: Logos and images uploaded by educational organizations are stored securely in cloud storage.
policiesPage.s4Box: Detailed student results and recorded answers during live classroom sessions are stored on our servers for 30 days only from the session end date. After this period, these records and data are permanently deleted to maintain server performance and protect privacy. Please record or note scores before this period expires.
policiesPage.s5Body: The platform offers free and paid (Pro) plans. Use of AI features is subject to defined quotas (such as number of requests and tokens used) which renew periodically based on your subscription plan. The platform reserves the right to temporarily restrict access if the fair use quota is exceeded to prevent abuse of AI resources.
policiesPage.s6Body: As a teacher or content creator, you are fully responsible for the content, questions, and hints you create and share with students through the platform. It is strictly prohibited to create or share any inappropriate, offensive, destructive, or intellectually infringing content.
policiesPage.s6Warn: The platform administration reserves the full right to monitor usage and suspend (block) or delete any account that violates these terms or attempts to circumvent quota and subscription systems without prior notice.
policiesPage.s7Body: We reserve the right to amend these terms and privacy policy at any time to keep pace with technical updates and regulatory laws. Your continued use of the platform after amending the terms constitutes your implicit agreement to them.

demo.title: Knowledge Adventure: Health & Wellness
demo.description: A quick educational game to experience the EduPlay platform, focusing on public health and healthy habits.

scenarios.title: Sports & Physical Activity
scenarios.description: You feel sluggish and want to increase your daily activity. What is the best option to start?

choices.feedbackMessage: Walking is a fantastic, low-impact exercise to revitalize your body and enhance blood circulation.
choices.feedbackTip: Try walking outdoors to soak in natural sunlight.

choices.feedbackMessage: You don't need expensive equipment to begin; simple bodyweight exercises are just as effective.
choices.feedbackTip: Consistency matters far more than gear.

choices.feedbackMessage: Energy drinks are packed with excessive sugars and caffeine that can harm your heart and sleep.
choices.feedbackTip: Natural exercise is the best source of sustainable energy.

choices.feedbackMessage: Oversleeping can actually amplify feelings of fatigue and sluggishness.
choices.feedbackTip: Maintain consistent sleep hours without oversleeping.

scenarios.title: Healthy Nutrition
scenarios.description: During exam season, you feel constantly hungry and need high concentration. What do you choose for a snack?

choices.feedbackMessage: They contain saturated fats that induce lethargy and impair mental focus.
choices.feedbackTip: Avoid greasy, fried foods during intense study periods.

choices.feedbackMessage: Nuts provide long-lasting brain energy and fruits are packed with vital cognitive vitamins.
choices.feedbackTip: Walnuts and almonds are renowned for memory support.

choices.feedbackMessage: Causes an immediate blood sugar spike followed by an energy crash that brings fatigue.
choices.feedbackTip: Choose wholesome natural sugars such as dates or raw honey.

choices.feedbackMessage: Your brain requires consistent glucose to process and retain complex information.
choices.feedbackTip: Hunger severely weakens your ability to comprehend and remember.

scenarios.title: Digital Wellness
scenarios.description: You spend long hours on your smartphone before sleeping and struggle to wake up energized. What is the solution?

choices.feedbackMessage: Caffeine disrupts sleep architecture and prevents deep, restorative sleep cycles.
choices.feedbackTip: Avoid caffeine at least 6 hours before you head to bed.

choices.text: Turning off all screens an hour before sleep
choices.feedbackMessage: Blue light suppresses melatonin secretion. Powering down screens dramatically improves sleep quality.
choices.feedbackTip: Try reading a physical book rather than scrolling on your phone.

choices.feedbackMessage: Even dim display illumination stimulates neural activity and reduces deep sleep.
choices.feedbackTip: It's best to put smart devices completely out of reach.

choices.feedbackMessage: Using medications without medical supervision can lead to dependency and adverse side effects.
choices.feedbackTip: Natural bedtime habits and regular exercise are always the best remedy.

help.subtitle: Your comprehensive guide to launching your first interactive game and engaging your students from start to analytics.
help.step1Desc: To create and manage your games, {mustFirst} (such as a school, educational center, or classroom).
help.step1MustFirst: you must first join or create an organization
help.step1WhyDesc: Organizations group and organize your games and analytics. You can also upload your school or brand logo to display professionally during gameplay.
help.step2Desc: Inside your organization, click {newGameBtn}. We offer smart tools to design your content with utmost flexibility:
help.step2AutoAiDesc: Enter your lesson topic (e.g. Water Cycle) and our built-in AI (Gemini) generates verified questions, choices, and explanations in seconds.

help.step3Desc: After configuring your game, save it as a draft. To play with students, {publishGame}:
help.step3LiveLaunchDesc: Changing game status to "Published" creates an active classroom session. Display the QR Code or copy the direct link onto your board for students to scan and join.
help.step3InstantJoin: Instant join without accounts: Students enter by typing their name only, without account registration or passwords.
help.step4Desc: As soon as students start playing, watch live data streaming on your session statistics dashboard:
help.step4MonitorTitle: What to watch during the session?

help.step4MonitorItem2Desc: Track score bands and overall classroom mastery.
help.step4MonitorItem3Desc: Pinpoint tough questions that tripped students up so you can clarify them immediately.
help.step5Desc: Once student responses are complete, {endSession} to close the stream and freeze final scores.
help.step5HistoryDesc: Access all past closed sessions anytime from the "Sessions" sidebar tab to review final student reports and export grades.
help.step5RetentionWarningDesc: Detailed session responses and student answers are stored on our servers for {thirtyDays} from the session completion date, after which they are purged. Be sure to export or record grades during this period.
